summary: Iteration 24: Verified Arabic article fields (title_ar/body_ar) end-to-end and SMTP-disabled email alerts. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass, admin UI creates/edits AR articles with green AR badge, /ar/media renders RTL Arabic content while falling back to English for others, /media shows English titles. Alerts banner appears on Enquiries+Bookings tabs (yellow, mentions et_reservations@eurogulf.ae + 'not active yet') and is hidden on Articles tab. GET /api/admin/alerts-status returns {smtp_configured:false, alert_email:'et_reservations@eurogulf.ae'} (401 without auth). Contact + booking POSTs stay <2s and only log 'SMTP not configured; alert skipped: ...' as expected. Failure isolation: emailer.send_alert() returns False without raising when SMTP host is unreachable.
critical_code_review_comments: emailer.py logs alert subject in error path via _clean(subject) which strips CR/LF (good), no log injection surface detected.

server.py update_article uses model_dump() without exclude_unset, so any field left at its default None is filtered by the truthiness check `if v is not None` (correct) — booleans False/True are preserved, so no silent field drop.
get_articles $or search on title/title_ar uses re.escape and length-limited (100 chars), safe. Falls back to LTR when title_ar absent as required.
SMTP creds are placeholders and SMTP_ENABLED=false by user choice; behaviour is correct (skip + log). Not a bug.
seed_data_creation: None; all TEST_ prefixed contact/booking/article data cleaned up after tests
